about: LAB-673: task sentences for the on-device task classifier, each with the kind a person would pick. 'accept' lists other kinds that are fair for an ambiguous sentence (lenient score). Kinds and descriptions come from agentic_engineering/skills/fleet/agent-routing/routing.json. Run: app/scripts/route-eval.py --model <file.gguf>.
